about: Docs fixes from the supermemoryai/supermemory history. Selection: every commit touching apps/docs between 2025-10-01 and 2026-11-13 whose message contains fix, align or drift (any case; 56 commits), and every HTTP call to api.supermemory.ai on a page that commit changed whose method, URL or body the commit changed or removed (154 calls in 11 commits). Each was read by hand: a case when the commit message names the problem as docs not matching the API, otherwise excluded with the reason. The problem each case should raise is written as the checker reports it; operation null means the path matches no operation.
